<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#EFF2F6"/>
  
  <!-- Status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="28" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="20" y="19" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#111111">9:41</text>
  <line x1="319" y1="15" x2="319" y2="19" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="324" y1="12" x2="324" y2="19" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="329" y1="9" x2="329" y2="19" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="342" cy="15" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="337" y1="15" x2="347" y2="15" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="1"/>
  <rect x="356" y="9" width="21" height="12" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="358" y="11" width="15" height="8" rx="1" fill="#111111"/>
  <rect x="378" y="13" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#111111"/>

  <!-- Header -->
  <rect x="0" y="28" width="390" height="66" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <polyline points="31,61 24,68 31,75" fill="none" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <line x1="25" y1="68" x2="39" y2="68" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <text x="195" y="70" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="22" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">Shortlist</text>
  <line x1="0" y1="94" x2="390" y2="94" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Main content -->
  <text x="24" y="132" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#111111">Your shortlist</text>
  <text x="366" y="132" text-anchor="end" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#979797">0 saved members</text>

  <!-- Empty state card shadow -->
  <rect x="20" y="153" width="350" height="351" rx="4" fill="#111111" opacity="0.06"/>
  <rect x="20" y="151" width="350" height="351" rx="4" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Empty state bookmark icon -->
  <circle cx="195" cy="218" r="42" fill="#EFF2F6"/>
  <rect x="181" y="196" width="28" height="39" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="2"/>
  <polygon points="181,229 195,220 209,229 209,235 195,226 181,235" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="187" y1="203" x2="203" y2="203" stroke="#A9ABBD" stroke-width="2"/>

  <text x="195" y="292" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#111111">No members shortlisted yet</text>
  <text x="195" y="321" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#979797">Save profiles you would like to revisit</text>
  <text x="195" y="342" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#979797">and keep your favorites in one place.</text>

  <!-- Primary button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="106" y="371" width="178" height="46" rx="3" fill="#000000"/>
    <text x="195" y="400" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Browse Members</text>
  </g>

  <line x1="49" y1="447" x2="341" y2="447" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="195" y="477" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#111111">Tip: select the bookmark on any profile</text>

  <!-- Guidance section -->
  <text x="24" y="553" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#111111">How shortlisting works</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="570" width="350" height="110" rx="4" fill="#111111" opacity="0.05"/>
    <rect x="20" y="568" width="350" height="110" rx="4" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="48" cy="599" r="13" fill="#000000"/>
    <text x="48" y="604" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">1</text>
    <text x="74" y="604" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#111111">Explore member profiles</text>
    <circle cx="48" cy="635" r="13" fill="#000000"/>
    <text x="48" y="640" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">2</text>
    <text x="74" y="640" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#111111">Tap the bookmark to save a profile</text>
    <circle cx="48" cy="671" r="13" fill="#000000"/>
    <text x="48" y="676" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">3</text>
    <text x="74" y="676" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#111111">Return here whenever you like</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="758" width="390" height="86" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="758" x2="390" y2="758" stroke="#5F5F5F" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- Members tab -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="43" cy="784" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#979797" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <ellipse cx="43" cy="797" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#979797" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="43" y="826" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#979797">Members</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Interest tab -->
  <g>
    <polygon points="121,780 123,786 129,786 124,790 126,796 121,792 116,796 118,790 113,786 119,786" fill="none" stroke="#979797" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="121" y="826" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#979797">Interest</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Shortlist active tab -->
  <g>
    <rect x="185" y="778" width="18" height="24" rx="2" fill="#000000"/>
    <polygon points="185,797 194,791 203,797 203,802 194,796 185,802" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="194" y="826" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">Shortlist</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Account tab -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="318" cy="784" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#979797" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <ellipse cx="318" cy="797" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#979797" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="318" y="826" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#979797">Account</text>
  </g>
</svg>
